title: CVE-2024-54134 Solana Supply Chain Vulnerability
text:
CVE-2024-54134 - Solana Supply Chain Vulnerability

CVE Details:
- ID: CVE-2024-54134
- Affected: solana-web3.js JavaScript SDK
- Type: Supply chain attack via compromised npm package
- Severity: Critical
- Published: December 2024

Attack description:
- Attacker compromised maintainer account of @solana/web3.js
- Published malicious versions 1.95.7 and 1.95.8 to npm
- Malicious code exfiltrated private keys from browser wallets
- Targeted dApps using affected SDK versions
- Private keys sent to attacker-controlled server

Impact:
- Any dApp using web3.js 1.95.7 or 1.95.8 affected
- Browser wallet private key exposure
- Estimated $160,000 in losses before detection
- Affected major Solana dApps temporarily

Detection method:
- Unexpected network requests to external domains
- Obfuscated code in npm package diff
- Hash mismatch with expected package content

Mitigations:
- Pin exact package versions in package-lock.json
- Verify package integrity hashes
- Use hardware wallets (keys never exposed to JS)
- Monitor npm package changes
- Enable 2FA on all package maintainer accounts
- Use Snyk/Dependabot for supply chain monitoring
Source: CVE-2024-54134, NVD
